Chapter 1072: 15: Lin Yuan And The Nine Profound Venerable (Vote For Monthly Ticket)_3

Chapter 1072: Chapter 15: Lin Yuan and the Nine Profound Venerable (Vote for Monthly Ticket)_3

Lin Yuan accepted the micro world, split off a trace of his mind to examine it, and discovered a large number of Stone People Clan inside, trembling with fear. These Stone People also knew their own fate; with a single thought from the Nine Profound Venerable, their entire clan could be annihilated.

“Where shall we duel?”

After checking several times and confirming there was no issue with the micro world, Lin Yuan put it away and casually asked.

“Just outside the secret realm.”

The Nine Profound Venerable replied.

Duels between Venerables are catastrophic in their destructiveness. While the Nine Profound Secret Realm was birthed by the Chaos Void, it clearly did not possess the indestructible characteristics of the universe itself.

If two Venerables were to fight inside the secret realm, the realm wouldn’t be able to withstand it and could directly collapse into ruin.

The Nine Profound Secret Realm was the lair of the Nine Profound Venerable. Naturally, he didn’t wish to see that happen.

“No problem.”

Lin Yuan’s figure slowly began to fade. “Half an hour later. See you outside the secret realm.”

As soon as the words fell.

Lin Yuan’s figure disappeared completely.

The Nine Profound Venerable, seeing this, did not worry that Lin Yuan would leave prematurely.

Firstly, because Lin Yuan had sworn under the will of the Chaos Void Origin, breaking the oath would bring karmic retribution upon him.

Secondly, whether winning or losing, there was no tangible loss for Lin Yuan. This was also the reason why the Nine Profound Venerable so readily handed over all the Stone People Clan.

“When did such a Venerable appear in the nearby Void Domain?”

The Nine Profound Venerable sat on his throne, silently pondering.

At the level of Chaos Venerables, one would typically share at least passing familiarity; they all knew of each other. Yet he had never heard of a Venerable named Lin Yuan.

“Could he have come from some distant Void Domain? Or could he, like myself, have only recently stepped into the Chaos Realm, and news of it hasn’t spread yet?”

The Nine Profound Venerable speculated inwardly.

Moments later.

Several Dominator-level experts cautiously entered the hall.

“Venerable…” These Dominator-level experts still didn’t know what had happened, but since the Cang Yulong they were guarding suddenly vanished, they were surely at fault.

“Enough. Retrieve all gathering points outside the secret realm into the secret realm, and activate the secret realm’s defensive formation at full capacity.” The Nine Profound Venerable instructed.

Encircling the Chaos Continent were countless “fragment worlds”; while the Nine Profound Secret Realm couldn’t compare to the Chaos Continent, it still hosted numerous gathering points.

In the impending battle between the Nine Profound Venerable and Lin Yuan, the aftermath would undoubtedly engulf these gathering points. Retrieving all of them into the secret realm would be the safest approach.

Furthermore, the Nine Profound Secret Realm itself needed to enter its highest defensive state to withstand the aftershocks of the two Venerables’ battle.

“Huh?”

“Venerable, why are we retrieving those gathering points?”

The Dominator-level subordinates looked shocked and puzzled. The Nine Profound Venerable did not reprimand them for their negligence in guarding but instead issued these instructions?

“Shortly, I will spar with another Venerable just outside.”

The Nine Profound Venerable’s words were brief, but the Dominator-level subordinates were deeply shaken.

Spar?

With another Venerable?

…

Far across layers of space and time.

The Taiyin Primordial Spirit stood silently in place.

Cang Yulong stood respectfully to the side.

“It’s done.”

A figure condensed—it was the Taiyang Divine Spirit of Lin Yuan.

“Two seniors?”

Cang Yulong was momentarily stunned before quickly realizing they were likely incarnations.

“These are your clanspeople.”

Lin Yuan flipped his right hand, and a micro world appeared. Within it were countless Stone People.

“Clanspeople…”

Cang Yulong’s expression turned emotional, his voice trembling slightly.

He had never imagined he would one day see his clanspeople again.

Though Lin Yuan had mentioned trying to save the Stone People Clan before bringing him out, it had only been a tentative promise.

The Nine Profound Venerable was not someone easy to deal with.

But now.

All the Stone People were right in front of him.

“Don’t get too excited.”

“The Nine Profound Venerable handed over the Stone People, but there are terms involved.”

Lin Yuan looked at Cang Yulong and proceeded to explain the agreement he made with the Nine Profound Venerable.

“Everything will be as you decide, senior.”

Cang Yulong replied respectfully.

Sharing a replicable inheritance with the Nine Profound Venerable?

To Cang Yulong, this was inconsequential. He had already planned to hand over that inheritance space to Lin Yuan, so naturally, he would follow Lin Yuan’s arrangements.

When Cang Yulong had been in the hands of the Nine Profound Venerable, his refusal to yield had stemmed from knowing that surrendering would likely still lead to death.

In fact, the Nine Profound Venerable might have exterminated not only him out of spite but also his entire clan.

Taking the Mysterious Space away in front of the Nine Profound Venerable had undoubtedly provoked immense anger.

“Alright.”

“My duel with the Nine Profound Venerable is imminent.”

“Now, you may tell me the exact space-time coordinates of that Mysterious Space.”

Lin Yuan looked at Cang Yulong and spoke in an even tone.

“Exact space-time coordinates…” Cang Yulong took a deep breath. Without the slightest hesitation, he revealed the coordinates.

Lin Yuan had fulfilled all his promises—not only rescuing him but also saving the entire Stone People Clan.

Cang Yulong dared not delay for even a moment.

Though Lin Yuan had always come across as incredibly kind in his demeanor towards Cang Yulong.

This only deepened his awe. Someone capable of forcing the ruthless Nine Profound Venerable to relent so thoroughly—how could Lin Yuan truly be as kind as he appeared?

If Lin Yuan were to be angered, Cang Yulong felt that his fate would be countless times worse than if he had remained in the hands of the Nine Profound Venerable.

“Space-time coordinates…”

Lin Yuan, having obtained the exact coordinates, began extending his perception toward it.

The space-time of the Chaos Void was vast beyond measure, layered across countless temporal planes. Even Chaos Venerables and Chaos Great Saints could not traverse them all.

Thus, space-time coordinates in the Chaos Void were of immense importance. Without exact coordinates, even a Chaos Great Saint could become lost in the endless layers of time and space.

Buzz. Buzz. Buzz.

Lin Yuan’s immense consciousness spread outward, following the coordinates provided by Cang Yulong until it locked onto a Mysterious Space deep within the layers of time and space.

“That space…”

Lin Yuan observed it carefully.
